-- pathfm-installer: file-manager start
hl.unbind("SUPER + SHIFT + F")
hl.unbind("SUPER + ALT + SHIFT + F")
o.bind("SUPER + SHIFT + F", "File manager", { launch = "$BIN_PATH" })
o.bind("SUPER + ALT + SHIFT + F", "File manager (cwd)",
  "uwsm-app -- $BIN_PATH \"\$(distro-cmd-terminal-cwd)\"")
-- pathfm-installer: file-manager end

# pathfm-installer: file-manager start
unbind = SUPER SHIFT, F
unbind = SUPER ALT SHIFT, F
bindd = SUPER SHIFT, F, File manager, exec, uwsm-app -- $BIN_PATH
bindd = SUPER ALT SHIFT, F, File manager (cwd), exec, uwsm-app -- $BIN_PATH "\$(distro-cmd-terminal-cwd)"
# pathfm-installer: file-manager end
